`upstream_to_canvas.json` holds each case's input as the official `--boxes` file would carry it (0-1) and the rows
that `flux3.bbox.to_canvas` returned for it. They were generated by importing `src/flux3/bbox.py` from
https://github.com/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein at commit e53f4ea697fe45db8f38fca91a90f5623f7f8f37
(Apache-2.0). The two `examples/inputs/*_boxes.json` cases are copied from that repository; the rest are synthetic.
The CI job re-derives the expected rows from a fresh checkout of the same commit (scripts/check_upstream_parity.py).
